newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 14.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
U.S. broker Montgomery Securities said on Wednesday night analyst John Tinker had downgraded News Corp Ltd to hold from buy. The stock ended at 21-1/2 Tuesday in U.S. trading, down 3/8th of a dollar.
Qantas Airways Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to introduce a 12 Australian cents a kilogram surcharge on long haul international freight rates from November 18 in reaction to higher fuel prices.
* Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd A$1.90 (+0.01)
The funds of international investor George Soros said on Thursday they had reduced their stake in Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd to 7.62 percent from 8.65 percent.
Woolworths and Arnotts hold their annual meetings later on Thursday.

Orogen Minerals Ltd said late on Wednesday it did not have any information for release to the market which could explain the recent surge in its share price other than point to information about its PNG oil exploration activities and recent share issue.

Forrestania Gold NL said on Wednesday it has discovered nickel mineralisation at its Roundtop joint venture near the Maggie Hays nickel find in Western Australia. An intersection of 6.7 metres grading 3.61 percent nickel from a depth of 193.3 metres was recorded, Forrestania said late on Wednesday.
